scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by thin vertical navy lines.

LEFT ZONE, the reporting line and who decides. At the top left, a small office building with a teal roof labelled INVESTMENT FIRM. Directly below it stands a person holding a notebook and a small megaphone, labelled ADVISER; the megaphone carries a small tag labelled INFLUENCE. A solid navy arrow points UP from the adviser to the building, labelled REPORTS TO. From the adviser a dashed teal arrow points RIGHT to a desk where a seated person works, labelled COMPANY LEADER; the dashed arrow is labelled ADVICE. On the desk lies a wooden gavel with a small tag labelled AUTHORITY. The megaphone stays with the adviser; the gavel stays on the desk.

MIDDLE ZONE, what employees hear. Three small engineer figures stand at the bottom looking up at three speech bubbles stacked vertically above them, each bubble with one small icon and one label: a magnifying glass in the top bubble labelled ASSESSMENT FINDING; a light bulb in the middle bubble labelled RECOMMENDATION; a gavel in the bottom bubble labelled AUTHORIZED INSTRUCTION.

RIGHT ZONE, when coaching becomes assessment: two separate permissions stacked vertically with a gap between them. Top: a closed notebook with a padlock on it, labelled COACHING NOTES, with a single key lying beside it labelled ONLY ALEX RELEASES. Bottom: a clipboard with a report sheet labelled NEW ASSESSMENT, carrying an ochre rubber stamp labelled INES OR BOARD APPROVES.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: INVESTMENT FIRM, ADVISER, INFLUENCE, REPORTS TO, COMPANY LEADER, ADVICE, AUTHORITY, ASSESSMENT FINDING, RECOMMENDATION, AUTHORIZED INSTRUCTION, COACHING NOTES, ONLY ALEX RELEASES, NEW ASSESSMENT, INES OR BOARD APPROVES. Any other text is a defect.
alt: An adviser holding a megaphone labelled influence reports up to the investment firm and sends a dashed arrow of advice to the company leader, whose desk holds the gavel of authority; engineers hear three kinds of message — an assessment finding, a recommendation or an authorized instruction; a padlocked notebook of coaching notes that only Alex can release sits apart from a new assessment that Ines or the board approves.
caption: Who the adviser reports to, what employees are hearing, and the two separate permissions when coaching turns into assessment.
